instructions: Restore a copied file by its capsule_path only into a fresh destination mapped from private_original_path; require exact SHA256 and preserve the original mode. Do not overwrite current live/private evidence or canonical sources automatically.

Older bf07 paths later superseded in place are mapped additively in repair/SUPERSEDED-BF07-PREIMAGE-RESTORATION-MAP.json; its immutable bf07-preserved preimages are included. V2/V3 fresh-path revisions are in repair/REVISION-MAP-V3.json.

The original native235 complete77-file owner export is included as original-native235/retention/root-owner-export-1.stdout.json, with its accepted length/hash/source map and physical-retirement review; original guest terminal and closed outer owner files are copied directly.

Large artifact hashes are reused from retained accepted receipts and were not recomputed. Omission is not deletion; all original private bytes remain. Compiler or native replay needs its separate dispatcher release.
